Tickets 2dbf-07bf-452d-4543 and 852a-1e41-632d-4087 COMPLETE (both had needed
description corrections, both re-reviewed PASS, both claimed, both implemented):

2dbf (Remove stale bare-`review` CLI guidance):
- RED test tests/unit/test_no_stale_bare_review_cli.py (9 tests) confirmed RED
  (3 failed) via git-stash revert-and-rerun before the fix.
- GREEN: corrected AGENTS.md ("deprecated and now forwards" -> "has been
  removed, not deprecated-and-forwarding") and docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md
  (removed "review" from CLI-forms list + "retained as an alias" claim).
  Verified docs/exit-codes.md needed no edit (confirmed via rg + read).
- Sandboxed mutation (macOS sandbox-exec): reverted AGENTS.md fix, confirmed
  test went RED, restored, reconfirmed GREEN.
- make lint clean (one ruff-format fixup). Committed 3dfd581e738a, pushed:
  change 2543 (stacked on 2538/2540/2541/2542).

852a (Document bug claim-RCA-review sequence explicitly):
- RED test tests/unit/test_bug_claim_rca_sequence_docs.py (6 tests) confirmed
  RED (4 failed) via git-stash revert-and-rerun before the fix.
- GREEN: added an explicit sequence paragraph to docs/plan-review-gate.md
  (~line 540): claim-without-review-for-RCA -> complex bug (non-test blast
  radius) must pass full LLM review before implementation -> simple bug may
  use the light tier. Existing tests/unit/test_bug_review_tier.py (13 tests
  total combined) still pass -- no code touched, doc-only fix confirmed by a
  test asserting gates.py's _PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES is unchanged.
- make lint clean (one ruff-format fixup). Committed 1052f711f40a, pushed:
  change 2544 (stacked on 2538/2540/2541/2542/2543).

Stack status: 2538 (6ba3), 2540 (c181), 2541 (1c70), 2542 (ecb4), 2543
(2dbf), 2544 (852a) -- 6 changes pushed, all on top of each other. 6 of 40
tickets code-complete. Checking Gerrit vote status next; then continuing to
22ec-e638-c896-4b54 (already claimed, not yet implemented) and the
originally-fetched ready batch (09f6, 6262, and story leaves).
